He read it three times, then pinned it to the wall beside the window, next to eleven other scraps collected over the years, each one a small proof that the sea carried more than weather and wreckage.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像是被按下了暂停键。路灯还亮着，橘黄色的光洒在空荡荡的马路上，没有行人，只有偶尔驶过的清洁车低声轰鸣。便利店的玻璃门里透出一点白光，收银员靠着柜台打瞌睡。远处高楼的轮廓安静地立着，窗户大多是黑的，只有几户还亮着灯，像是谁的失眠。风从巷子口吹过，带着一点凉意和隔夜的油烟味。这个时候的城市不属于白天的喧嚣，也不属于深夜的孤独，它只是安静地喘息，等待着下一班地铁的轰鸣把它重新唤醒。", "w03": "Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller piece of that problem.\nIt keeps calling itself on smaller and smaller pieces until it reaches something so simple it can answer right away (this is called the base case).\nThen each call passes its answer back up to the one that called it, like a chain of dominoes falling back into place, until the original question gets answered."}
